desc: The Winchester Bismuth Waterfowl Shotgun round is exceptional choice for waterfowl hunting in even the wettest environments. With the water resistant double seal wad, and Lacquered Primer this shot shell will perform in the nastiest of environments. This ammo will give you the reach you need to fill your freezer. Take Winchester Bismuth Waterfowl with you on your next water fowl hunt and get more game in the bag!
